title: Extension by zero of the unit module is flat
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and let $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ be the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every object $U$ of $\mathcal C$, let $\mathcal O_U$ be the restriction of $\mathcal O$ to the localized ringed site $\mathcal C/U$, let $P$ be its extension-by-zero presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf], so $P(V)=\bigoplus_{\varphi\in\operatorname{Mor}_{\mathcal C}(V,U)}\mathcal O(V)$, and let $j_{U!}\mathcal O_U=P^\#$ be its sheafification as a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Then the extension-by-zero module sheaf $j_{U!}\mathcal O_U$ is flat over $\mathcal O$ [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]: tensoring with it over $\mathcal O$ preserves finite limits (equivalently, the tensor functor on $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ is exact).

source.place: Lemma 18.28.7 (Tag 03EV), clause (2), j_{U!}O_U is a flat sheaf

proof.text: Let $P$ be the extension-by-zero presheaf of $\mathcal O_U$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf]; since $\mathcal O_U(V\xrightarrow{\varphi}U)=\mathcal O(V)$, for every object $V$ of $\mathcal C$ it has $P(V)=\bigoplus_{\varphi\in\operatorname{Mor}_{\mathcal C}(V,U)}\mathcal O(V)$, with $\mathcal O(V)$ acting summandwise. This is a free $\mathcal O(V)$-module, hence flat. Finite limits of presheaves and tensor products of presheaves are computed objectwise, so tensoring with $P$ preserves finite limits; this is the objectwise-flat-presheaf criterion of Stacks Tag 03ES (Lemma 18.28.2).

source.place: Lemma 18.28.2 (Tag 03ES), together with the formula in Lemma 18.28.7 (Tag 03EV), proof of clause (1)

proof.text: By the statement, $j_{U!}\mathcal O_U$ is the sheafification $P^\#$ of this presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]; since $\mathcal O$ is already a sheaf, $\mathcal O^\#=\mathcal O$. Applying [lem-pc-sites-modules-sheafification-flat] to the finite-limit-preserving tensor functor from Step 1 shows that tensoring with $P^\#$ over $\mathcal O$ preserves finite limits in $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$. Therefore $j_{U!}\mathcal O_U$ is flat, as asserted.
